disposition_reason: A real typed-button CER evaluator and strict packet checks are delivered. Authentic neural observation delivery, decoder execution and intended-key paper parity are not; qualify the measured typed-button endpoint before adding access claims.

scientific_target.question: Can held-person, held-session MEG or EEG observations recover observed typed-button sequences better than a matched language-only comparator under a frozen sentence-template split?
scientific_target.known_answer: The ordered mapped V1 typed-button classes for each eligible sentence; this is observed keypress content, not corrected intended sentence text.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Private operator reconstruction from pinned V1 behavioral logs aligned to neural events; the evaluator validates supplied alignment inventories but does not reconstruct raw DTW.
scientific_target.case_unit: An opaque sentence query nested in a resolved biological person and physical session.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Resolved person within one modality; do not combine EEG and MEG as disjoint people without an identity map.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Predictive recovery of typed content with declared event assistance and target-person calibration; statistical association does not establish linguistic rather than motor origin.
exclusions: Continuous unassisted typing or causal cognitive-content recovery.
Native neural understanding from an executable decoder score.

inputs: Pinned V1 MEG or EEG recording-derived sentence observations; exact public asset bytes remain operator-provisioned.
Training labels and a prospectively equal count of calibration sentences AND keystrokes for each target person; zero calibration allowed.
forbidden_inputs: Query keycodes, typed/intended transcripts, template text, answer-bearing filenames and logs.
Unresolved cross-modal person sharing, query-dependent preprocessing or evaluation feedback.
observation_contract.case_identity: Evaluator requires unique opaque 32-hex query IDs and per-sentence neural-asset hashes. Authentic full ID roster is not bundled.
observation_contract.split: Implemented checks keep canonical people out of training versus target phases, complete source sessions and reconciled visits in one phase, and entire template families/normalized text collisions in one phase. Authentic family derivation and physical-visit map remain unverified.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete selected sentence inventory is required, but no authentic selected cohort or neural payload is bundled. V2 and cross-modal pooling are excluded.

primary.name: Neural-only person-macro sentence character error rate
primary.aggregation: Unit-cost Levenshtein edits/reference length per sentence, equal sentences within person, then equal people; retain insertions giving CER above 1.
primary.rationale: Measures recovery of observed held-out characters without rewarding a language rescorer or people with longer transcripts.

secondary: Paired neural-only minus language-only CER by person; negative favors neural observations.
Optional fixed-LM arm reported separately; constant and empty prediction diagnostics.
Alignment exclusions and residuals, full query count and per-person support.

comparators.name: Matched language-only
comparators.inputs: Training corpus/calibration and exactly the declared fixed LM identity; no query neural signal or transcript.
comparators.procedure: Required complete prediction artifact. Comparator fitting/competence is not proved by its lm_id metadata.

comparators.name: Pinned V1 neural decoder
comparators.inputs: Same allowed V1 neural observations and calibration budget.
comparators.procedure: Prospective source-derived reference; not executed by the evaluator package.

nuisance_controls: Resolve MEG subject aliases before all splits.
Freeze template-family grouping and DTW exclusions before evaluation.
Retain ocular/motor contamination as an unresolved alternative; language-only comparison alone cannot isolate cerebral linguistic information.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented paired person cluster percentile bootstrap with frozen seed/replicates; one person is descriptive only. Cross-modal identity, template dependence and authentic inclusion require external audit.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject duplicate/extra/missing IDs, malformed alphabet, unknown target definitions, unexplained alignment loss and split leaks; no partial score. Empty predictions are valid complete deletion controls.

implementation.scorer_target: Actual evaluator.py scores private V1 typed-button class sequences against complete text submissions with person-macro sentence CER. It grades measured behavior, not copied paper tables.
implementation.delivered_scope: Standard-library typed-button evaluator, query-manifest allowlist and generated engineering tests. Neural assets and participant execution are separate.
missing: Raw DTW and complete source selection verification.
Authentic alias/physical-session/template maps and cross-modal identity.
Neural decoder/reference execution, protected delivery and same-task paper endpoint parity.
implementation.execution_evidence: The 16 existing generated evaluator tests passed during this revision. They test arithmetic, identities, malformed outputs and split/privacy checks; no authentic data or model was run.

direct_observation.representation: A fixed neural observation packet with channel/time/coordinate units and the same declared calibration support, answered without execution.
direct_observation.boundary: No evaluator targets, source-label lookup, other-case memory or model/numerical tools; a direct response is evaluated separately from programme results.
missing: Authentic complete observation presentation and no-tools response collection have not been delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed navigation over the permitted neural observation, with units and calibration examples.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only rendered allowed observations; no raw target arrays or unrestricted filesystem/code access. A plot alone does not establish viewer execution.
missing: Task-specific renderer/action API, complete case collection and restrictive transport are absent.

tool_assisted.representation: Case-local numerical/model-assisted investigation under a fixed observation and compute entitlement.
tool_assisted.boundary: Current query inspection may inform an allowed proposal; fit/selection remains training-only and evaluator outcomes are inaccessible. Fresh case state is required.
missing: A legacy manifest or prediction scorer does not deliver the participant investigation runtime.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted source, fitting/adaptation recipe and complete prediction output contract.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before query access; equal declared calibration and no post-query selection from evaluator feedback. Programme success does not measure unaided interpretation.
missing: No executable participant programme is present in the assigned package.

title: Neural typing character reconstruction

evidence.supports: Preserved source identity, original endpoint, allowed observations and unresolved source/qualification limits.
Actual target mapping, complete-ID validation, alignment/split checks and CER arithmetic.
Source-derived typed-versus-intended endpoint distinction and explicit generated-test/native limits.

evidence.locator: Pinned official loader: event alignment and person identity warning
evidence.supports: Behavioral logs and neural recording alignments require explicit source joins; source subject labels are not necessarily biological identity.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No task-specific solver result is established by the inspected package. The repository historical programme pilot remains confined to NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077; no result transfers here.
excluded_claims: Continuous unassisted typing or causal cognitive-content recovery.
Native neural understanding from an executable decoder score.

summary: Promote the actual typed-button evaluator into the current target description without claiming intended-text parity.
Make sentence-versus-person weighting, uncapped CER and absent participant observation delivery explicit.
revision.source_review: Inspected the original registration and the actual public implementation files listed in evidence. Primary official sources were checked where needed; historical execution declarations remain scoped, not promoted.
